I fixed the float display and committed it as `6c7516d` ("Format report totals to two decimals"). All 10 tests pass.

The repo has no file literally called "big report". Two modules print raw float sums with the same bug, so I fixed both:

- **`src/orders-api/sales_report.py`**: per-customer totals now use `:.2f`. This is the module named "report".
- **`src/orders-web/quarterly_export.py`**: the per-order `total` column now uses `:.2f`. This is the "every order in a quarter" export, which is arguably the bigger report.

I used `:.2f` because `csv_export.py` already formats money that way. The existing sales test expected `Lindqvist: 2` and `Okafor: 4`, so I changed it to `2.00` and `4.00`. I also added tests for the `0.1 + 0.2` case in both modules. Before the fix, both produced `0.30000000000000004`.

If you only meant one of the two reports, I can revert the other in a follow-up commit.
